remarks: The Key To Your Dream Patio Home awaits in the highly desirable Essex Greens @ Waterford in Clarence Center! Built in 2023 & in Pristine condition, this exceptional 3-bedroom, 3-full-bath residence offers 3,057 sqft of beautifully designed living space w/ high-end upgrades inside & out.Impressive curb appeal welcomes you with professional landscaping, an expansive concrete driveway and walkways, stone accents and oversized windows that fill the home with natural light. Step inside to a bright, open-concept floor plan designed for both everyday comfort and entertaining. Upon entering you'll notice a welcoming foyer and office/den perfect for anyone working from home. The Open Concept Chef’s Dream Kitchen is a showpiece featuring white shaker cabinetry, quartz countertops, an oversized center island w/seating, stainless steel appliances, statement lighting, custom backsplash & a striking range hood. 2'nd Bedroom is on 1'st floor with a shared full bath between the office & bedroom.The kitchen flows seamlessly into the dining & living areas perfect for all your entertaining needs. A sun-filled bonus sitting/sunroom provides the perfect place to relax and opens directly to the outdoor living space. Backyard oasis features a composite deck overlooking green space & pond plus has a spacious concrete patio—ideal for entertaining, dining or unwinding outdoors. 1'st floor Primary Suite w/ walk in California closet features a tray ceiling and a beautifully upgraded Spa Bath w/ dual vanities, extensive cabinetry, marble looking tile & an oversized glass-enclosed walk-in shower. Three bedrooms total and three full baths provide flexibility for guests, home office or additional living space. The 2'nd floor offers the 3rd bedroom & full bath with its own private living room area . Garage entry has built in bench/seating area, coat closet and Laundry Rm. Lower level has endless possibilities with plenty of room to finish. Additional upgrades include a Culligan whole-house water softener and filtration system plus purified drinking water. Snow removal up to the door, lawn care, front landscaping maintenance & water included. Also listed as Patio Home under MLS ID #B1720775
